It is a snapshot that you must do at the beginning of every game session and is only required for pushing the highest Pit/Tower tier possible. This bug has been "green-lit" by the developers for this season.

Swap you ‍Seal of the Diamond Mind for ‍Seal of the Golden Epiphany and check your two Uniques charms. Both Aspects should be colored in, instead of greyed out as if you've deactivated them.

Endgame Rogue is a very powerful build with visually destructive vibes that looks as strong as it feels. It is a build that has no foundational weakness. From its wide AoE and ability to gather, while being effective in single target situations makes this one of the best all around builds in the Rogue arsenal. While this incredibly fun build is easy to play, there's a caveat...
This is one of the most gear dependent builds on Rogue.  It is recommended that you play another setup and farm for the very specific gear and stats necessary to play this build. This is

version, by nature the setup doesn't like anything that can't be crowd controlled, bringing about inconsistently in damage as with all
builds. The transition into Full Damage and Tower Push variants can also be a bit intimidating and not as smooth of a journey as the
Once you put it all together, you'll be happy you did. Well worth the journey. This guide walks you through everything you need to destroy in sanctuary!
Many things are unknown going into Season 15. Expect to see quick and frequent updates to the guide throughout the first week of the season as things are vetted.
Can I use a Crossbow instead of a Bow?

Yes. There's no real difference between the two for effectiveness. Crossbow is slower, but stronger hits while Bow is faster, but weaker hits. It amounts to roughly the same DPS. Bow is more popular primarily due to how it looks and arguably better transmogs, but you can choose either one.
Bossing sucks on cold builds. Help!

If lair bossing/mephisto/lilith are farming priorities, it is best to get another 2h bow and imprint High Velocity aspect on it, with the exact same stats as your main Bow. Using the new bow makes bossing significantly easier as you're not relying on stagger to trigger Frozen Memories huge multiplier.

While this does not apply to Pit or Tower, the difference is night and day on Lair bosses and your happiness stat increases. You can technically weapon swap in pit to take advantage of only using the bow with frozen memory on it right before boss is staggered for maximum output, it's not a strategy I'd recommend for everyone, but is viable in higher level pits.
